name: popover-form
blurb: Button animates to a form panel, shows success state on completion.
description: A controlled popover that morphs from a button to a fixed-size form with success state display. Spring-animated with optional close button at top. Includes composed success screen and utility icons for visual polish.
use_when: You need a form that feels lightweight and doesn't disrupt the page flow, with a dedicated success state.
avoid_when: Complex multi-step forms — this is optimized for single-screen flows.
a11y: Click-outside and Escape to close. Title aria-hidden in open state. Submit button with loading state. Success state is visual only, no additional ARIA.
